Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, with complaints of neck and back pain
consistent with a strain mechanism. The reported symptoms align well with the nature and force of the impact described.
Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while neurological screening, reflexes,
and motor strength remained within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical or lumbar regions is known to this
provider. Care consisted of ten visits including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction, following a
conventional course of conservative management. Symptoms improved steadily over the treatment period, and visit frequency
was reduced accordingly as function returned. Billed services correspond to the documented visits, with no duplicate or repeated
charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
